summary.result: The developed H/W & S/W for integrated abrupt disaster forecasting & alarming system was verified by field application.
summary.background: The objectives of this research have been focussed on 1) developing prediction techniques for the flash flood and landslide based on rainfall prediction data in agricultural area and 2) developing an integrated forecasting system for the abrupt disasters using USN based real-time disaster sensing techniques.
summary.method: There are limitations in terms of communication distance and cost using Zigbee and CDMA which have been used for existing disaster sensors.
